q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales fell by ₹172,296 (from ₹356,317 → ₹184,022) this week vs the same weekdays last week; orders fell from 188 → 98 and ad spend fell from ₹215,617 → ₹123,353 (all figures are by order date, Tilting Heads brand default).  

- What moved most: orders dropped 90 (188 → 98), the largest single contributor to the net sales decline; average order value also slipped slightly.  
- Ad spend fell ~₹92k (₹215,617 → ₹123,353), which reduced traffic/orders and explains a large part of the volume drop.  
- Platform concentration: the fall is concentrated in paid channels (Meta & Google); Meta in particular contributed a large share of the decline in net sales versus the comparison period.  
- Profit view: reported net profit improved (loss narrowed) from -₹19,069 → -₹5,733 because ad spend fell faster than sales, reducing the P&L loss despite lower revenue.

Worth checking: drill channel-level and top-ad performance (Meta vs Google and the ad names that went to zero) to confirm whether budget cuts, paused ads, or poor ad performance drove the orders drop.

Period: 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 vs 2026-10-05..2026-10-07 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
